title: Write
subtitle: 本課限定語境：write = to produce words in written form, create a text, prepare a written version,
description: 本課限定語境：write = to produce words in written form, create a text, prepare a written version, or express an idea in language · 「寫；撰寫；草擬；用文字表達」

words.note: 表示有意識地組織語言，寫成一篇完整或相對完整的文字。
words.example: She composed a short email explaining the delay.
words.exampleZh: 她撰寫了一封簡短電郵，解釋延誤原因。

exercises.original: She wrote a polite email explaining why the meeting had to be postponed.
exercises.zh: 她撰寫了一封有禮貌的電郵，解釋為何會議必須延期。
exercises.upgrade: She composed a polite email explaining why the meeting had to be postponed.

options.explanation: 也可能，若這只是第一版；但句子沒有任何「之後還會修改」的線索。
a polite email explaining... 表示完整組織語言寫成一封訊息，compose 很自然。
表示從別處抄寫，不表示原創撰寫。
只表示簡短記下，不適合完整 email。
可以記錄資訊，但不自然表示撰寫電郵。
表示把語音或已有內容逐字轉寫，不是自己組織措辭。

exercises.original: The student wrote a short essay comparing the two novels.
exercises.upgrade: The student composed a short essay comparing the two novels.

options.explanation: essay 是 compose 的典型受詞，重點是有結構地創作完整文字。
如果只是初稿可用，但句中沒有 preliminary version 線索。
只會表示濃縮內容，不等於寫比較文章。
只列出項目，不是寫 essay。

exercises.original: He wrote a careful message to the client after reviewing the complaint.
exercises.upgrade: He composed a careful message to the client after reviewing the complaint.

options.explanation: 表示留存資訊，不表示精心措辭。
careful message + client context 表示刻意組織語言，compose 最自然。
只表示列出大綱，未必形成完整 message。

words.note: 表示寫出初步版本，之後通常還會修改。
words.example: The lawyer drafted a new version of the agreement.
words.exampleZh: 律師草擬了一個新版協議。

exercises.original: The lawyer wrote the first version of the contract before sending it to the client for comments.
exercises.zh: 律師先草擬了合約第一版，再送給客戶提供意見。
exercises.upgrade: The lawyer drafted the first version of the contract before sending it to the client for comments.

options.explanation: 可以表示寫成文字，但 first version + for comments 明確指出這是初稿階段。
first version 是 decisive clue；draft 正是「草擬初稿」。
簽署發生在內容完成之後。

exercises.original: Before the board meeting, she wrote a preliminary proposal for discussion.
exercises.upgrade: Before the board meeting, she drafted a preliminary proposal for discussion.

options.explanation: 表示正式發布，和 preliminary 狀態不符。
preliminary proposal 表示尚未定稿，draft 最精確。

exercises.original: The team wrote a first version of the report and planned to revise it the next day.
exercises.upgrade: The team drafted a first version of the report and planned to revise it the next day.

options.explanation: first version + planned to revise 直接說明它不是最終稿。
可以表示撰寫報告，但不突出初稿階段。
表示公開發表，明顯太早。

words.note: 表示把原本存在於心中的想法、感受、印象或經驗轉化成語言。
words.example: It was difficult to put her feelings into words.
words.exampleZh: 她很難把自己的感受用文字表達出來。

exercises.original: She found it difficult to write how she felt after the accident.
exercises.zh: 意外後，她很難把自己的感受用文字表達出來。
exercises.upgrade: She found it difficult to put into words how she felt after the accident.

options.explanation: draft 通常接 document / report / letter，不自然直接接 emotions。
可以 formulate a response，但對個人感受來說語氣太正式、理性。
how she felt 是這個表達最典型的語境：把難以言喻的情緒轉成語言。
只是把感受記下，不強調能否表達清楚。
需要已有語音或文字來源。

exercises.original: It took him several minutes to write exactly what he wanted to say.
exercises.upgrade: It took him several minutes to put into words exactly what he wanted to say.

options.explanation: exactly what he wanted to say 表示困難在於把內在想法轉成適當措辭。
通常只是簡短記下，不表示尋找合適表達。
不是把已有語音轉文字。

exercises.original: The witness struggled to write the experience clearly because it had been so frightening.
exercises.upgrade: The witness struggled to put the experience into words because it had been so frightening.

options.explanation: 如果是正式證詞報告可以用，但句子重點是情緒經歷難以表達，而不是文件格式。
the experience + so frightening 強調把難以表達的經驗說清楚。
只是機械記錄，不含表達困難。
問題不是長短，而是能否準確表達。

words.meaning: 組織措辭；擬定；形成表達
words.note: 表示仔細思考後，精確地組織一個說法、回答、政策、問題或論點。
words.example: The committee formulated a careful response to the criticism.
words.exampleZh: 委員會仔細擬定了對批評的回應。

exercises.original: The committee wrote a careful response to the criticism.
exercises.zh: 委員會仔細擬定了對批評的回應。
exercises.upgrade: The committee formulated a careful response to the criticism.

options.explanation: careful response 表示需要精確思考和措辭，formulate 很自然。
太簡短，不能表達完整回應的形成。

exercises.original: Researchers wrote a question that would not influence participants' answers.
exercises.upgrade: Researchers formulated a question that would not influence participants' answers.

options.explanation: 也可能，若只是先做初稿；但句子重點是 carefully designing wording to avoid bias。
research question wording requires deliberate, precise construction, which is exactly what formulate conveys.

exercises.original: The spokesperson needed time to write an answer that was accurate and legally safe.
exercises.upgrade: The spokesperson needed time to formulate an answer that was accurate and legally safe.

options.explanation: accurate and legally safe 顯示重點是仔細構思措辭，而不是單純把字打出來。

words.note: 表示撰寫一整篇正式作品並成為作者。
words.example: She authored a report on urban transport.
words.exampleZh: 她撰寫了一份關於城市交通的報告。

exercises.original: She wrote a report on urban transport for the research institute.
exercises.zh: 她為研究機構撰寫了一份城市交通報告。
exercises.upgrade: She authored a report on urban transport for the research institute.

options.explanation: 如果只是初稿才更精確；句子沒有 preliminary 線索。
a report + formal institutional context fits author as “write and be responsible for the work.”

exercises.original: He wrote three books on modern architecture.
exercises.upgrade: He authored three books on modern architecture.

options.explanation: 只表示寫筆記，不是創作整本書。
books 是 author 最典型的受詞之一，表示他是這些作品的作者。
是把既有作品轉成另一語言。

exercises.original: The scientist wrote the paper together with two colleagues.
exercises.upgrade: The scientist co-authored the paper with two colleagues.

options.explanation: 和 with two colleagues 直接矛盾。
多人共同成為文章作者，co-author 是最精確表達。
引用資料只是論文工作的一部分。

words.note: 表示把資訊、名字、數字、想法等記錄在紙上或裝置中。
words.example: Please write down your phone number.
words.exampleZh: 請把你的電話號碼寫下來。

exercises.original: Please write your phone number so I do not forget it.
exercises.zh: 請把你的電話號碼寫下來，免得我忘記。
exercises.upgrade: Please write down your phone number so I do not forget it.

options.explanation: phone number 不需要組織成完整文本。
重點是把一個已知資訊記錄下來，防止忘記。

exercises.original: She wrote the address in her notebook before leaving.
exercises.upgrade: She wrote down the address in her notebook before leaving.

options.explanation: address 是已存在的資訊，不需要組織形成。
in her notebook 是典型 recording context。

exercises.original: During the meeting, I wrote several ideas that I wanted to discuss later.
exercises.upgrade: During the meeting, I wrote down several ideas that I wanted to discuss later.

options.explanation: ideas 只是記錄，不是完整作品。
如果把每個 idea 發展成完整論點才適合；此句只說先記下來。
during the meeting + discuss later 表示快速記錄想法以備之後使用。

falseSynonyms.zh: 打字 ≠ write 的所有意思 type 說的是輸入方式；你可以手寫，也可以打字完成同一篇文章。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can write a report by typing it, but typing describes the physical input method rather than the act of creating the text.

falseSynonyms.zh: 抄寫 ≠ 創作 copy 表示把已有內容重複寫出，不一定涉及原創。
記錄 ≠ 所有 write note 常表示簡短記下重點，不適合完整文章或正式文件。
草擬 ≠ 最終撰寫 draft 通常只是第一版；final version 可能還需 revise / edit。
著作 ≠ 一般短文字 author 通常需要完整作品，不適合普通短訊、表格或便條。
表達想法 ≠ 文件撰寫 它特別適合把思想／感受轉成語言，而不是一般行政文件。
- writer = 作者／寫作者 - write = 寫（動詞）
- written = 寫成的；書面的 - writing = 寫作／文字
